en: The postcard shows an artistic illustration of a painter painting an urban park with a large fountain, surrounded by prominent 19th-century buildings. The scene depicted on the canvas is labeled 'Vängåfvan' and the city name 'SUNDSVALL' appears in the top right. The reverse side includes Swedish handwritten text and addresses, designed in an old-fashioned divided-back style.
